rows.title: Episode 5: Millionaire Village
rows.title_native: エピソード#05 富豪村
rows.note: 2017 (day unsourced at the required tier — see flag 1). Mail-in all-volume-purchase bonus DVD for the TV anime JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable BD/DVD Vol.1-13; the application coupon shipped inside Vol.13 (2017-06-28, licensor), so the disc itself was delivered later — a dated fan review of the received disc is 2017-09-23, and the two JoJo wikis (one lineage) give 2017-09-20. david production's own works page dates the work only '2017年'. NOT an event release: its first public screening anywhere was overseas (Crunchyroll Expo, San Jose, 2019-08-30, billed 世界初上映). Licensor per-episode page: jojo-animation.com/ova/rohan/story/episode05.php.

rows.note: Disc. DVD bundled with the limited 'アニメDVD同梱版' of manga volume 2 (Shueisha, ISBN 978-4-08-881557-2). Licensor prints 「7月19日(木)発売」 (jojo-animation.com/du/bddvd/ova2.html); Thursday checks out. ja-WP and en-WP both carry 2018-07-19.

rows.title: Episode 16: At a Confessional
rows.title_native: エピソード#16 懺悔室
rows.note: Event screening. Premiered with row 4 at the opening night of the licensor's six-city screening tour 「岸辺露伴は動かない」全国六都市上映ツアー 奇譚見聞録, Tokyo TFT HALL 1000 (Sunday, 昼公演 15:00 / 夜公演 18:15). Disc release later: Blu-ray/DVD 「ザ・ラン／懺悔室」 and the 4-episode Collector's Edition, both 2020-03-25 (水). ja-WP's 各話リスト prints the DISC date (2020-03-25) for this row — see flag 2.

rows.title: Episode 9: The Run
rows.title_native: エピソード#09 ザ・ラン
rows.note: Event screening. Same premiere as row 3 (奇譚見聞録 Tokyo, 2019-12-08). Order within the shared date taken from the premiere programme's own billing 『懺悔室／ザ・ラン』 in the official event report, and from ja-WP's and en-WP's list order — see flag 3. Disc release 2020-03-25.

numbering_basis: Release order of THIS run's own four entries, 1-4, by first Japanese release (row 1 = 2017 mail-in bonus disc, row 2 = 2018-07-19 bundled disc, rows 3-4 = 2019-12-08 event premiere). The licensor does NOT number the run: every OVA is titled by the MANGA one-shot's own episode number (#05 富豪村, #02 六壁坂, #16 懺悔室, #09 ザ・ラン), which is a source-chapter label, never a run ordinal — kept in title / title_native so the label is not lost. Rows 3 and 4 share a date; tie broken by the premiere programme 『懺悔室／ザ・ラン』 (the production committee's own event report) plus ja-WP's 各話リスト order and en-WP's OVA 3 / OVA 4.

sources.what: Official OVA site (Warner Bros. Japan / 岸辺露伴は動かない製作委員会). Carries all four episodes and the disc listings: Collector's Edition 2020年3月25日（水）4話収録, and 「ザ・ラン／懺悔室」 2020年3月25日（水）2話収録.

Licensor page for the 全巻購入特典 OVA itself (富豪村): staff, cast, synopsis, 60秒PV. No release or shipping date is printed — checked live and on three Wayback snapshots (2017-06-28, 2017-08-29, 2017-10-28).
Licensor page for 「岸辺露伴は動かない」第2巻 アニメDVD同梱版: 「収録内容：OVA「六壁坂」／7月19日(木)発売」, 予価3,500円+税, ISBN 978-4-08-881557-2, 集英社刊 — row 2's date.
Official JoJo portal, 「岸辺露伴は動かない」OVA ＜コレクターズエディション＞: 発売日 2020年3月25日（水）, 4話収録（「六壁坂」「富豪村」初収録）— the disc date for rows 3-4 (and the first disc release of rows 1-2).
The studio's own works list, archived 2017-10-16: 「Blu-ray＆DVD全巻購入特典／完全新作OVA「岸辺露伴は動かない」 2017年」 — the studio dates row 1 to the YEAR only. (This is the source en-WP cites for its year-only value.)

Infobox first = September 20, 2017; episode table Japan dates 2017-09-20 / 2018-07-19 / 2020-03-25 (ep 9) / 2020-03-25 (ep 16); prose: application deadline 2017-07-31, theatrical screenings from 2019-12-08. Dated fan review, 2017-09-23 20:06: 「ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 ダイヤモンドは砕けない Vol.1〜13購入特典である、完全新作OVAが届きますたので見ますた」 — the mail-in disc had just arrived. Circumstantial only, but it proves the disc was in buyers' hands in late September 2017 and therefore that 2017-06-28 is not its release date.

アニメージュプラス, 2019-09-09: 富豪村's 世界初上映 at Crunchyroll Expo 2019, San Jose, 2019-08-30 (Warner Japan panel), and 「『富豪村』は…Blu-ray/DVDの全巻購入特典としてのみ視聴できるエピソード」 — i.e. as of Sept 2019 the episode had had no public screening in Japan at all.

超！アニメディア, 2017-06-28: the 富豪村 staff/cast comments release. Prints 「Vol.1～12 好評発売中」 and the application instruction 「Vol.1～13に封入されている『全巻購入特典応募券』にてご応募ください」 — Vol.13 was not yet out on 2017-06-28 and the bonus was an application, not a purchase.

flags_for_sean: ROW 1 DATE IS NULL (P6). No source at the required tier gives a day for 富豪村. The year is licensor-solid (david production's works page: 「2017年」). ja-WP prints 2017年6月28日 in BOTH its 各話リスト and its BD/DVD table, but the licensor's own Vol.13 page shows 2017-06-28 is DiU BD/DVD Vol.13's release date — the volume that CONTAINED the mail-in application coupon; the disc could only be delivered after applicants sent that coupon in (deadline reported as 2017-07-31), so ja-WP's value is a conflation. en-WP refuses a day outright with an inline 'do not change to a more specific date without a source' note. The community value is 2017-09-20 (jojowiki.com + jojo.fandom — ONE lineage, so one cross-check), corroborated only circumstantially by a fan review dated 2017-09-23 saying the disc had just arrived, and by the fact that 2017-09-20 is a Wednesday (the normal JP disc weekday). YOUR CALL: leave null, or accept 2017-09-20 as a cross-check-tier value with the note attached.

ROWS 3/4 DATE — a real source split, resolved toward the event per the ask. The licensor's tour page + en-WP give the 2019-12-08 premiere screening (Tokyo TFT HALL 1000, six-city tour 奇譚見聞録); ja-WP's 各話リスト gives 2020-03-25, which is the Blu-ray/DVD date (both discs, per the licensor and the JoJo portal). Grid uses 2019-12-08 and names the disc date in each row note. If the catalog would rather hold home-video dates for OVA rows, rows 3 and 4 both become 2020-03-25 and the run's span becomes 2017 → 2020-03-25.

ROWS 3/4 ORDER — 懺悔室 before ザ・ラン. Evidence for: the premiere programme's own billing 『懺悔室／ザ・ラン』 in the production committee's official event report, the 2019-08-18 announcement wording 「懺悔室」「ザ・ラン」, ja-WP's 各話リスト order, en-WP's OVA 3 / OVA 4, jojo.fandom's table order. Evidence against: the retail disc is titled 「ザ・ラン／懺悔室」 and the Collector's Edition is listed 「ザ・ラン / 懺悔室 / 六壁坂 / 富豪村」, and jojowiki.com orders 9 before 16. The disc's track order is not the release order; both share one date either way, so this is presentation only.

TASK PREMISE PARTLY FAILS (a claim, not a fact). (a) There was no '2017-09 event' — September 2017 is the SHIP window of a mail-in bonus DVD, not a screening; 富豪村's only screening was overseas (Crunchyroll Expo, San Jose, 2019-08-30, billed 世界初上映), which is itself proof it had never screened publicly in Japan. (b) The 2019 pair was not tied to a JoJo exhibition — it premiered on the licensor's own 奇譚見聞録 screening tour. (c) 'The 2018-07 second' and 'the 2020-03 Blu-ray' hold exactly as stated.
COUNT CHECK PASSES: 4 rows = AniList 21778's 4 episodes. No recap, no bonus row, no split.

ANILIST WAS UNREACHABLE during this research — graphql.anilist.co returns HTTP 403 'temporarily disabled due to severe stability issues', and anilist.co/anime/21778 serves a JS shell. Episode count and the 2017-2019 span are taken from the task. When the API returns, read 21778's startDate: if it is 2017-09-20 that is a third (independent-ish) witness for row 1's day; if it is 2017-06-28 AniList inherited ja-WP's conflation. AniList's END being in 2019 already agrees with 2019-12-08 rather than the 2020-03-25 disc.

MANGA-NUMBER TRAP HELD, and it is load-bearing for the later standing work: the four OVA titles carry the MANGA one-shot numbers (#05, #02, #16, #09 — ja-WP's chapter table lists them in publication order 16, 02, 05, 06, …). Those are source labels; they must never be read as this run's episode numbers, and #09 ザ・ラン is the fourth ROW even though 9 < 16.

en-WP NAMESAKE / SAME-PAGE HAZARD (G55-adjacent): 'Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan' is a redirect; the live article 'Thus Spoke Rohan Kishibe' holds FOUR tables — chapters, the OVA episode table, and the LIVE-ACTION NHK drama episode table (whose ep 1 is also titled 'Millionaire Village', aired 2020-12-28). Any later scrape of this article must scope to the ==Original video animation== section.

LATER RELEASES, deliberately not used as row dates: Netflix worldwide 2021-02-18 (all four); NHK 総合 first TV broadcast 2021-12-18 (懺悔室 + 六壁坂) and 2021-12-20, i.e. late 19th (富豪村 + ザ・ラン). Note the NHK pairing is another ordering again, and Netflix numbers 'At a Confessional' as its episode 1 — three published orders exist for this run, none of them release order.
